hook: How do you pick an AI architecture the board will actually approve?
bullets: Discovery turns clinical needs into hard pass or fail gates
A higher quality option is dropped for missing the 3 second SLA
Only gate survivors are compared on cost
An ADR is sent back until it records rejected alternatives and trade-offs
cta: Watch the flow, then go deeper in the full course:
shows: This short animation shows why the latency SLA is checked before cost when choosing an architecture.
